h: Marketers unveil new petrol landing cost as NMDPRA sets conditions for import licences
p: Fuel marketers have announced a new landing cost for petrol, while the downstream regulator NMDPRA has set conditions for petrol import licences. The update is likely to affect pump prices in the coming days.
more: Marketers say the landing cost depends on exchange rates and shipping costs.
Motorists are waiting to see whether pump prices change.
